description_en: Deletes multiple domain name registrant profiles
description_zh: 批量删除域名联系人模板
name: DeleteContactTemplates

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the registrant profiles to be deleted. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

A registrant profile ID is automatically generated by the system after the registrant profile is created. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html operation to query registrant profile IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的信息模板的编号，传入多个值时使用逗号（,）分隔。

信息模板创建成功后由系统自动生成，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_ids
